summary: Private and public capital markets data on companies, deals, investors and funds.
access_note: API key issued by PitchBook under a separate contract plus purchased API credits; sandbox key via account manager.
blocker_note: API requires a separate standalone contract with PitchBook and purchased credits; no self-serve key.

evidence.quote: PitchBook will provide you with a unique API key that will allow you to make calls to the API.
Please reach out to your account manager to request a sandbox key.
In addition to an API key, please make sure you have purchased API credits.
This API is a RESTFUL implementation that can be easily accessed by most HTTP clients in the language of your choosing.
Powered by our MCP server, PitchBook clients can seamlessly search and analyze firms, deals, funds, and key players.

notes: PitchBook's own help page (pitchbook.com/help/pitchbook-api) returned 403, so access terms rely on the Postman-hosted API reference. MCP listing is on Claude's connector marketplace; PitchBook-run status inferred from 'our MCP server' wording and endpoint on pitchbook.com domain; requires PitchBook subscription sign-in. Direct Data API breadth assumed moderate (companies, deals, people, investors, funds, LPs, service providers).
